//: The Grand Stenchmaster's Stench Log. Entries unlock with story flags; later notes replace earlier ones through variants. Future chapters add entries here (or in another file under data/logs/).

entries.title: Day 1
entries.notes: Atmosphere predominantly Garrick. Excellent start.

entries.title: Day 2
entries.notes: Still Garrick. Written in advance, to save time.

variants.notes: Still Garrick. Written in advance. Entirely accurate.

entries.title: Treasure Room
entries.location: Aft hold, behind the heavy door
entries.notes: Successful atmospheric rebranding. The gold now guards itself.

entries.title: Captain Squawks
entries.notes: Plumage pending. Attitude unchanged. Requests feathers back (outside warranty).

variants.notes: Seven feathers grown, seven returned to the environment. Recurring molt. (The Captain has asked me not to call it that.)
Seven new feathers, one of them golden. Morale: excellent. Stability: we shall see.
Three new feathers. The golden one, and two more coming in green.
One new feather. Yellow. The Captain says it is golden. The Captain is being kind.

entries.title: The Captain's Beard
entries.notes: Root-deep. Has reached the beard beneath the beard. Estimated duration: centuries.

variants.notes: Excellent scent retention. (CAPTAIN DOES NOT APPROVE.)
Excellent scent retention.
Inspected daily, from a safe distance. Finding: beard still terrible. Useful for shark forecasting.
Useful for shark forecasting. Also, apparently, bait. The Captain objects to both.
Root-deep. Estimated duration: centuries. Revised upward (it started raining).

entries.title: The Grog Barrel
entries.notes: Now Frog Grog. All of it, forever. Fresh stock converts within the day.

entries.title: The Sails
entries.notes: Puff up with no wind. Possible propulsion. Safety: unknown.

entries.title: Ropes & Rigging
entries.notes: Crew advised not to ask. Crew asked. Crew regrets asking.

entries.title: The Ship's Bell
entries.notes: Coughs on the hour. Tone: bronchial.

entries.title: Hammocks
entries.notes: Is the smell alive? Debatable.

entries.title: The Guns
entries.notes: Yellow smoke anticipated. Enemy morale: will suffer. Gunner's morale: already has.

entries.title: Navigation Chart
entries.notes: Smells worse nearer the destination. The navigator disputes this. The chart does not.

entries.title: The Masked Rat
entries.notes: Has made itself a nose-cloth. Adapting faster than the crew.

variants.notes: Has made itself a nose-cloth. Nominated Assistant Stenchmaster. Motion defeated. The rat abstained.

entries.title: Sharks
entries.notes: Cheese: small ones. Garlic: hammerheads. Beans: large. Eel: yes.

variants.notes: A controlled release, well away from the ship, draws them off. Tested. Works. You're welcome.

entries.title: Port Side, Midships
entries.notes: Sharks. Many. Hull patched. Sharks unimpressed.

entries.title: Drinking Water
entries.notes: One yellow bubble. Frog Water. Barrel closed. Do not reopen.

entries.title: Rowboat 'G.G.'
entries.notes: Field office. Slightly bitten. One oar, one frying pan.

entries.title: Stenchmaster Protocol
entries.notes: Any unusual stomach noise: rowboat, downwind, farther than last time. Current standard: another ocean.

entries.title: The Dead Center
entries.location: Wherever it likes (see the Forecast Board)
entries.notes: The part that still remembers coming out. Hotter, thicker and yellower than the rest. Moves about. Do not stand in it.

entries.title: Stench Forecasts
entries.source: The Office of the Grand Stenchmaster
entries.notes: Posted every morning. Accuracy: developing. See board.

entries.title: The Breakfast Table
entries.notes: Forecast correct to within four seconds. Mister Bob's biscuit has been reclassified as part of the Center.

entries.title: The Washroom
entries.notes: Mister Gristle: twelve minutes, three ahead of forecast. Positive thinking works.

entries.title: Mister Pete's Pillow
entries.notes: Do not smell the pillow.

entries.title: Shark Duty
entries.notes: Not my department. See: Shark Management.

entries.title: Dead Center / Waterline
entries.location: Port rail, midships, and the sea underneath
entries.notes: Excellent response.

variants.notes: Excellent response. (The Captain has asked, in writing, which part was excellent. The sharks' part.)

entries.title: The Wake
entries.notes: Advertising. Very effective.

entries.title: Ship's Parrot
entries.location: His basket, by the cabin door
entries.notes: Recurring molt: concluded.

variants.notes: Recurring molt: concluded. (The parrot has asked me to add that he is 'confirmed'.)

entries.title: The Grand Stenchmaster's Office
entries.notes: Seat: ready. Grog: assured. Readiness: executive.

variants.notes: The Center visited the office. The office was improved.

entries.title: Stenchmaster Entertainment System
entries.notes: Channel integrity monitored. Thoroughly. The turnip is winning.

entries.title: The Grand Stenchmaster Suit
entries.notes: Holds a scent for weeks. I have been asked why that is a good thing. I have not dignified it.

entries.title: The Emergency Rule
entries.notes: One (1) useful thing per genuine emergency. 'Leadership' under appeal.

variants.notes: One (1) useful thing per genuine emergency. Today's: one shark, booted. Excellent technique. 'Leadership' under appeal.

entries.title: The Grand Stenchmaster's Supper
entries.notes: Warning issued per regulations. Captain disputes timing. Chair relocated for seat-warming purposes. Workplace confirmed (trousers).

entries.title: S.E.S. (Status)
entries.notes: Turned off WITHOUT authorisation during overnight seat-warming operations. Had a difficult shutdown. Threw one (1) fork (defensive). Do not throw overboard.

variants.notes: Attacked by a shark. A GRAY one. I will know it. Franklin's last words: 'tax deduction'. Convalescing. Do not throw overboard.

entries.title: The Mightiest Gust Yet
entries.notes: Notes of aged garlic, bright onion top, Frog Grog for body, cheese finish (Tuesday). Ship inflated. Broadside fired (we are pirates). A proper Grand Stenchmaster event. Tradition starts somewhere.

entries.title: The Grand Stenchmaster's Great Sharkstorm
entries.notes: Named by me. Branding objected to by the Captain. Powered by concentrated odour (they know).

variants.notes: Not destroyed. DISCOURAGED. The discouragement has worn off. There are no more barrels. I have suggested a Grand Sharkmaster be appointed to deal with it.
Repelled with the official beverage. Sixteen barrels. Still turning, a long way off. Remember who saved ye from it.

entries.title: Dietary Restrictions
entries.notes: No rotten garlic. EVER. Also onions, beans, cabbage, cheese. Soup: query pending. Bulk Frog Grog reserve: gone. A difficult time to hold this office.

entries.title: The Grand Stenchmaster Aura
entries.notes: Formerly residual Stenchmaster exhaust; the Captain has forbidden the phrase. The new name is better. The crew disagree. The crew are not on the naming committee.

entries.title: Grand Sharkmaster
entries.source: Established by me, during an argument
entries.notes: Department: sharks. Duties: the sharks. Not the stench (a different office). Applications: the pirate employment market (full of sharks; conflict of interest). [Underneath, in the Captain's hand: NOT REAL.]

entries.title: The Cape Incident
entries.notes: THE FORECAST ONE and THE MEDAL ONE, and a tassel. The crew declined a recovery mission. Ceremonial property. Recorded for the inquiry.

entries.title: The Song of the Grand Stenchmaster
entries.status: Performed (a verse, the chorus, half a verse)
entries.notes: Interrupted by the Captain at the second verse. Audience participation enthusiastic and hostile. The parrot hid, which I take as awe. A triumph.

entries.title: The Stenchmaster Entertainment System Mark II
entries.notes: Built during the storm out of the old one and some of the ship. Receives The Frog Tax Man. Signal routing by horseshoe. Fine tuning by spoon. Startup: warm-up.

entries.title: A Pleasant Evening
entries.source: Sixteen pirates, a ham and a frog
entries.notes: Everyone watched. EVERYONE. Grand Stenchmaster morale. (The Captain has asked me not to write that. I have written it small.) One episode, then I see about the storm. After this one.

entries.title: The False Alarm
entries.notes: Hunger, digestion, ordinary wind, or the beginning of something. I could not rule it out. I could not rule it in. Sometimes the fart is sneaky. The crew fled to the stairs. Bob got into a cask. It was not required, on this occasion.

entries.title: The Grand Stenchmaster Sash
entries.notes: Sacred. Heritage. Must be held off the ground by two bearers during any major event (ceremonially). Volunteers: none. [Underneath, in the Captain's hand: FART SASH.] [Underneath that, mine: STENCHMASTER SASH.]

variants.status: Claimed: ancient ceremonial relic. Known: a sketchy discount shop, last week
variants.source: A discount bin. 70% off. Cash only. No refunds. No receipt.
variants.notes: CLAIMED ORIGIN: ancient ceremonial relic. ACTUAL KNOWN ORIGIN: a sketchy discount shop. Purchased last week. Seventy per cent off. Cash only. No refunds. (Revealed by me, in my sleep, which is inadmissible.) Captain's note: FART SASH. Grand Stenchmaster's correction: STENCHMASTER SASH. It was a very good deal.

entries.title: The Grand Crown
entries.source: Fake gold, bottle caps, Jim's cutlery, the pump handle, the bell's clapper
entries.notes: The Grand Stenchmaster's Grand Crown. Crest: a stink-cloud over an onion, two spoons crossed. A little saucepan on top, for gravitas. [Captain: Jim wants his forks back.]

variants.notes: It slipped, once, in the night, onto the Captain. Forks, a spoon, the saucepan. Nobody was hurt. The Captain screamed anyway. He has called it GRAND STENCHMASTER CUTLERY. It may still be worn while awake, ceremonially. I have checked.

entries.title: The Lost Fart (my account)
entries.notes: GARRICK'S CLAIMS: the Temple of the Grand Stenchmaster; its seven chambers; the Golden Bottle of Wind; Sir Garrick the First (an ancestor; strong family resemblance); the ancient Grand Nap; the Bridge of the Sacred Sash; the Electric Frog Oracle; the Lost Fart. [In the Captain's hand: NONE OF THIS HAPPENED. IT IS A BEDTIME STORY. THE ORACLE IS THE TELLY.]

variants.notes: GARRICK'S CLAIMS (told in full, at bedtime, from a blank ledger): the Temple of the Grand Stenchmaster in the Lost Realm of Reekhollow; seven chambers; the Golden Bottle of Wind; Sir Garrick the First; the forbidden cheese; the ancient Grand Nap; the Bridge of the Sacred Sash; the Electric Frog Oracle; Professor Barnacle Bob; a giant rolling onion; the Lost Fart. Moral: always hold the sash. [Captain: NOT HISTORY. NOT TRUE. NOT EVEN A GOOD STORY.] [Pete: the onion was good.]

entries.title: The Old Sleeping Quarters
entries.notes: Not the Dead Center. The Center moved on; the Center is a free spirit. This is what it left behind: embedded, steeped, settled into the boards. The fart took residence. Estimated tenancy: centuries. Sign: CONDEMNED. GRAND STENCHMASTER ATMOSPHERIC EVENT. ENTER AT OWN RISK. [Captain: DO NOT ENTER.]

entries.title: The Lower Hull Barracks
entries.notes: Hammocks over the crates; a cargo net; a contraption of belts; Jim's pantry (padlocked); a cradle for the parrot beside the Captain; and over the Captain's bunk, the highest hammock. Rank. [Gristle: Altitude.]

entries.title: The Grand Nap
entries.notes: Restorative rest. Digestive authority. Banned by the Captain until I can say whether I am about to kill everyone. I can't.

variants.notes: Taken at night, in full ceremonial attire, for the continuity of office. The Suit has STENCH RETENTION (FWOoF). The Captain calls it fabric contamination. Nobody else slept. I slept beautifully.
